## Approval gates

- [ ] Public diff contains only approved non-sensitive material.
- [ ] Required CI passed on the current change; no unavailable verification claimed as success.
- [ ] Independent review covers the current commit and findings are resolved.
- [ ] Independent QA verified acceptance; independent security evidence covers the exact change and blocking findings are resolved.
- [ ] Human decision recorded before merge; no deployment or paid work is implied.
